summary_en: FY3/26 full-year dividend raised to ¥72.47 per share from ¥68.34 per share. Parent-attributable earnings uplifted to ¥7,677M from ¥7,234M. Target payout ratio approximately 30%. Annual dividend remains year-end only.
title_en: Notification on Revision of Dividend Forecast for Fiscal Year Ending September 2026 (Dividend Increase)
translation_en_brief: M&A Capital Partners announced on 30 July 2026 a revision of its FY3/26 (ending 30 September 2026) dividend forecast. The company raised the full-year dividend per share to ¥72.47 from the previously forecast ¥68.34. The increase reflects an upward revision of parent-attributable earnings to ¥7,677 million, from the initial forecast of ¥7,234 million. The dividend remains payable as a year-end distribution only (no interim dividend). The company states its core capital-allocation policy is to pursue stable and continuous shareholder returns primarily through dividends, targeting a payout ratio of approximately 30% while investing for business expansion in the growing business succession M&A market. The revised forecast aligns with this target payout ratio and reflects continuing per-share dividend growth driven by earnings accretion.
